d:
A timeless melody of love, longing and memories, Maheroo Maheroo returns in stunning 8K, bringing the soulful voice of Shreya Ghoshal back to life.
Song: Maheroo Maheroo
Singers: Shreya Ghoshal & Darshan Rathod
Lyricist: Sanjeev Chaturvedi
Composed by: Sanjeev-Darshan
Mixed and mastered By Eric Pillai (Future Sound of Bombay)
Movie - Super Nani
Presented By - Bharat Shah
